title: Longest Subarray With Maximum Bitwise AND
goal: Find the longest subarray attaining the maximum possible bitwise AND.
strategy: A singleton maximum value attains the global maximum AND. No smaller value can belong to a subarray with that AND, so the answer is the longest consecutive run of the array maximum.
